name: Katanamiko no Reiraku
source:
Main heroine is a shrine maiden who defeats youkai in acts of exorcism. But one day she gets overpowered by youkai and loses her chastity. She is confined in a room of an abandoned house and trained every day to become a sex slave.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是一位在驱魔行动中击败妖怪的巫女。但有一天，她被妖怪制服，失去了贞操。她被关在废弃房屋的一个房间里，每天接受训练成为性奴隶。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
